summary: Iteration 22 - Admin Broadcasts & In-app Announcements. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (/app/backend/tests/test_iter22_broadcasts.py). Frontend: full E2E on mobile viewport (390x844) with lingesa4 - Profile -> admin-open -> admin-broadcast-open -> form fields (title/message/aud chips/push switch/preview) -> send; sent card renders LIVE badge + reach/dismissed/push meta; Discover tab shows AnnouncementBanner for 'all' broadcast; dismiss hides and persists after reload; broadcast-end-<id> ends the broadcast (ENDED badge + dismissed count=1). All TEST_ broadcasts cleaned up. Trader plan verified = advance.
critical_code_review_comments: broadcasts.py:33 iterates ALL users and calls billing.compute_access per user for tier filtering; fine for current scale but will be O(N) on every create - consider indexing/aggregation if user base grows past ~100k.

broadcasts.py:84 filters dismissed in Python after fetching top 20 active, so a user with 20+ dismissed could end up with an empty list even if newer unread ones exist. Minor edge case; current limit of 20 is reasonable.

Announcements.tsx:17-19 optimistically removes the item from state then fires dismiss POST without awaiting - if the request fails (e.g., 404 for unknown id or network drop), UI state diverges from server until next focus refetch. Acceptable UX for banners but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Test broadcasts were created during tests with TEST_ prefix and all have been ended via cleanup. Confirmed no remaining active TEST_* broadcasts in DB. Trader is on plan 'advance' as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run iter22 tests with -n 0 (no xdist parallel) because the test module uses a shared _created dict for broadcast IDs across classes. If xdist is forced, pytest will split classes across workers and the dict will be empty in sibling workers. Alternatively promote _created to a pytest fixture scoped=session. Backend URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. One pre-existing active non-test broadcast ('T adv only') was intentionally left in DB because it does not start with TEST_.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All acceptance criteria met: audience filtering (all vs tier vs expert), 403 for non-admin, 422 for empty title / bad audience, 404 for unknown dismiss/end, per-user dismiss (idempotent), admin list dismissed counter, and DELETE flips active=false and removes from /api/announcements. Frontend admin UI, Discover banner, dismiss persistence and end flow all verified in web preview.
